visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in his late 40s wearing a khaki button-up shirt over a white tee stands on a moving escalator in a brightly lit shopping mall. He holds a black briefcase in his right hand and a smartphone in his left, gesturing while speaking to the camera. (2) The scene cuts to the man walking into a clothing store. He stops in front of a shelf displaying trousers and looks directly into the camera lens with a slightly tired expression. (3) A close-up of the man's face reveals reddened eyes; he points towards his eye area while explaining something. The background shows blurred clothing racks and mannequins. (4) He pulls down the collar of his khaki shirt to reveal a yellowish stain on the white t-shirt underneath. He points at the stain with a concerned finger gesture. (5) The man moves to a section with stacked white t-shirts on white shelves. He picks one up, showing the brand's packaging, and gestures toward the different styles available while continuing to talk. (6) He stands at a service counter, talking to a store clerk whose back is to the camera. He is holding a white shirt on a hanger. (7) Returning to the escalator, the man is now wearing the same outfit but holding a shopping bag. He gestures broadly, concluding his narrative with a smile.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle vlog where the creator explains the convenience of Uniqlo's high store density. He uses a personal anecdote about staining his shirt while hungover to demonstrate the practicality of being able to quickly buy a replacement basic white tee, while humorously mentioning his hope for a brand sponsorship.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly states that Uniqlo does not look for him for endorsements and '求業配' (seeks endorsement) in the captions.
